note.title: Multi-Depot Dock Booking Trial Review Meeting
note.summary: The meeting covered 60 agenda items reviewing late delivery performance across six depots (Bendigo, Geelong, Mildura, Shepparton, Warrnambool, Ballarat). Each item followed an identical pattern: late deliveries attributed to forklift roster conflicts and shared loading dock congestion between 06:00–08:00, with dock slot booking trials approved as the response. A total of 60 dock booking trials were approved across the six depots, each with a named owner, budget, and week-based deadline.

sections.heading: Attendees
points: Speaker A (chair — role/surname not stated in recording)
Speaker B (presenter for all items — role not stated; named individuals introduced per item: Ben, Chloe, Dmitri, Ella, Farid, Grace, Hamish, Ivy, Jack, Aisha)

sections.heading: Agenda items discussed
points: Items 1–60: Each item covered a named depot (Bendigo, Geelong, Mildura, Shepparton, Warrnambool, or Ballarat). The same depots recur across multiple items — Bendigo appears in items 1, 7, 13, 19, 25, 31, 37, 43, 49, 55; Geelong in items 2, 8, 14, 20, 26, 32, 38, 44, 50, 56; Mildura in items 3, 9, 15, 21, 27, 33, 39, 45, 51, 57; Shepparton in items 4, 10, 16, 22, 28, 34, 40, 46, 52, 58; Warrnambool in items 5, 11, 17, 23, 29, 35, 41, 47, 53, 59; Ballarat in items 6, 12, 18, 24, 30, 36, 42, 48, 54, 60.

Each presenter reported late deliveries for that month at the relevant depot, attributed to two causes: (1) forklift roster issues and loading dock shared with night crew; (2) gate queuing congestion between 06:00 and 08:00 when trucks arrive simultaneously.

Late delivery counts stated per item: Item 1: 3 | Item 2: 6 | Item 3: 9 | Item 4: 12 | Item 5: 15 | Item 6: 18 | Item 7: 21 | Item 8: 24 | Item 9: 27 | Item 10: 30 | Item 11: 33 | Item 12: 36 | Item 13: 39 | Item 14: 42 | Item 15: 45 | Item 16: 48 | Item 17: 51 | Item 18: 54 | Item 19: 57 | Item 20: 60 | Item 21: 63 | Item 22: 66 | Item 23: 69 | Item 24: 72 | Item 25: 75 | Item 26: 78 | Item 27: 81 | Item 28: 84 | Item 29: 87 | Item 30: 90 | Item 31: 93 | Item 32: 96 | Item 33: 99 | Item 34: 102 | Item 35: 105 | Item 36: 108 | Item 37: 111 | Item 38: 114 | Item 39: 117 | Item 40: 120 | Item 41: 123 | Item 42: 126 | Item 43: 129 | Item 44: 132 | Item 45: 135 | Item 46: 138 | Item 47: 141 | Item 48: 144 | Item 49: 147 | Item 50: 150 | Item 51: 153 | Item 52: 156 | Item 53: 159 | Item 54: 162 | Item 55: 165 | Item 56: 168 | Item 57: 171 | Item 58: 174 | Item 59: 177 | Item 60: 180.

Each presenter noted: depot supervisors had attempted staggered arrivals, which had only partly worked; on some days trucks waited over an hour. Scanning equipment was investigated and ruled out as a contributing factor.
Each presenter proposed a dock slot booking trial covering at least the 06:00–08:00 peak window, to run over the next month to assess impact on late deliveries.
Each proposal was agreed by the chair. Code words were assigned per item: ZX1Q through ZX60Q (items 1–60 respectively).

Note: the same depot names recur across multiple items with different owners, budgets, and code words. The basis for treating the same depot as separate agenda items is not explained in the recording.
